reviews.title: It’s okay, but…
reviews.text: If you are taking the time to read this, thanks. This game is fun, but it has issues. 1: it’s adult sometimes and may talk about adult things. Mind you, I’m 11 years old, so I find this disturbing… 2: it’s kind of sexist. I am female, and i hate how some choices depend on your gender (and there isn’t a gender neutral option for genders either). For example, when your asked what sport you want to join, if your female, which is what I was playing as at the time, if you choose cheerleading, your happiness goes up, if you choose football, your happiness goes down. I don’t like it when games do this, and I asume if you play as a male, it will be the other was around. But yea, these are some of my concerns and complaints about this game, along with some minor things like how some of the kills are a little… gruesome and other stuff, but that’s too long to fit in a review. Thank you if you read this! The only reason I didn’t give it 1 star is because it’s kinda fun but I should delete it

reviews.text: This game is all around great, with only minor issues. It didn’t work on my old tablet, though the game didn’t look too complicated to play on an older system. Y know what I also kinda dislike? Microtransactions. I know it’s a small game with no ads (and let’s be honest, most of the stuff is obtainable within a few hours), but you’ve gotta be kidding me with how short the boosts last. Of course, this doesn’t affect my views, as I am but a humble guy who hates hating things for no big reason. I hope you can see success in the future!

reviews.title: Favorite game
reviews.text:
This is by far my favorite app. It has funny jokes and even a South Park reference. There are some things that make the game less appealing these mainly being the lack of community. There are hardly any discussion posts online which make it tricky if you get stuck on a quest. Right now I need to figure out how to cheat death and idk if it was a bug, but the breath of life didn’t work. 

The best part is definitely the different game modes you can play. I’m challenging them that since there isn’t really a name. You can choose to make ur character an assassin, wizard, or superhero. To get these, you slowly unlock them with gems. You can spend money to get them, but it’s very possible to earn them from achievements and quests.

There are also some plot stuff that’s confusing. For example, there is a card where your parents die and you must decide how to spend your inheritance. Sometimes this card will come when ur 80 or following it will be a card about the dead parents where they are very much alive.

reviews.title: Awesome Game, But If You're A Parent Purchasing This For A Child, Please Read
reviews.text: Okay, first of all, the age rating on the game is kind of screwed up. 12+ rating isn't really acceptable, because the game talks about a lot of adult content and cusses a lot. It isn't graphic, just words, so I guess it's okay for about 14+? Also, you can now choose the gender and the name of your character, but not the appearance. I don't have a problem with that, but maybe a customization update would be cool. Other than that, it's a pretty awesome game. Interesting plot, good graphics, and oddly addictive. No ads unless you're trying to get coins for watching a video. This is probably one of my favorite games, and I love all the great and fun ideas in it. There are a bunch of fun things you can be in, like a gang or mafia or zombie apocalypse or you could be a superhero, so it's pretty good. Thanks for reading!

So like maybe a year ago or something I downloaded this after seeing a guy named “GrayStillPlays” and I was having the time OF MY LIFE! Then I think I deleted it and I saw this game today. But.... every time I open my app it ask for notifications “sure” but after it loads who the creators are or whatever it says “Nirvana” but it doesn’t fully load! Like the blue and red star thing loads for not even a second and then freezes. And I deleted my games hoping it was my storage. NOPE NOT AT ALL! I reopened the app multiple times, still doesn’t work. I deleted it and downloaded it again SEVERAL TIMES! BUT IT STILL DOESN'T WORK! This isn’t even just me from other reviews it looks like others are experiencing this problem. 
This game was really fun when I first had it though! That’s why it’s 3 stars. I’m really disappointed right now because I loved this game and I bought the pack for like zombie apocalypses, superhero’s, gangster, etc. But I’m truly sad because it won’t load! Please fix this problem because this was one of the funniest games I’ve ever played!

reviews.title: cool concept, needs improvement
reviews.text:
i've been playing for a couple days now and really do enjoy this game. the concept is great, i love choice based games, but i have a couple critiques that could make this even better.

1. there needs to be a bit more proof reading done, especially in the add on packs.
2. more choices concerning your character's identity would be great. maybe choosing attributes that they have at the start would make it less repetitive as the game goes on. i can only roll my eyes at the gendered choices (movies, halloween costumes) so many times. it'd also be cool to have the option to marry someone of the same gender. it just feels really limiting right now, like i'm playing as the same person every single time no matter what.
3. more choices in general would be great to see. i know there's add on packs, but the base game gets so, so repetitive after even just five or so lives.

in general, i like this game, but know that it could be fleshed out into something so much more complex with even just a few additions!

reviews.title: Worth the time n space and no forced ads!
reviews.text:
I did not download this for a long time because of the huge download size for a text based game. It is a lil big…. Buuuut.  
Considering the crap I downloaded in the meantime I must say I wish I would have downloaded this instead.
 Sure it’s a text base game and a fake life simulator… but it’s fun. Love the 8 bit pixelated art style. It’s a tad minimal in the art department but not in the story department and I haven’t even finished an entire Playthrough… only died like 4 times so far. I Kinda just pick it up here and there because I don’t want to rush through it.
But from what I have experience so far it is interesting,  more fresh than other text app games i’ve tried… and boy is it daaaaark. If you have a dark/twisted sense of humor I think you will love this game. It doesn’t seem to require  memory work or have homework or even alot of reading; You just make decisions, and see how they play out… And sometimes when you make those choices you get a bad result or you die… but I have a dark sense of humor and this game tickles it greatly… so much I don’t mind dying just to hear how… I promise you it is a lot more fun than a lot of ACTIVEgames you’re going to find in the store. 
And I have not had one ad that I did not request!….
 at least that I’m aware of 
and too many games force them now
